listing.summary: The main focus will be starfighter battles, so the missions will be fairly straight-forward dogfights, with support ships and Corvette/Frigate groups.Campaign integration will not be meant necessarily as vanilla balanced, so it may be published as a separate mod, or bundled with the campaign.
listing.aiSummary: Adds starfighter battles and dogfight missions with support ships and corvette/frigate groups.

description:
The main focus will be starfighter battles, so the missions will be fairly straight-forward dogfights, with support ships and Corvette/Frigate groups.Campaign integration will not be meant necessarily as vanilla balanced, so it may be published as a separate mod, or bundled with the campaign.

This post will be updated for documentation of the mod.

Demo download: 0.02a

DEV EDITION HERE Requires latest version of LazyLib.

Sprites so far:
Older ships (Will be kept in mod for nostalgia.)

Spoiler
Old Siifran Ships:

Belken-class Superiority Fighter
Spoiler
The Belken is one of the most advanced starfighters available in the system, boasting dual light assault guns and two Swarmer pods built into the nose.
What makes the Belken such a powerful starfighter is it's relatively small size and efficient shield generator. Command variant has Active flares rather than Fighter flares.
Found in squadrons of six (One Command fighter, five in a wing) during planned combat, but patrols are made up of one Command fighter and two escorts.

Sparrow-class Strike Corvette.
Spoiler
Hopefully will be armed with two IR Pulse Repeaters mounted in front of the cockpit[Built-in, hidden],
a Swarmer pod in the midsection (two Swarmers facing each side, hidden/Built-in), and strike missiles built-in under the wings
(Hopefully with animated pod doors). All weapons will be built-in, so it's role is very specific- providing heavy weapons support to fighter squadrons,
and being able to hold it's own in a full-scale battle against anything smaller than a light destroyer.
With maneuverability to match a Belken, moderate 180-degree front shields, and light armor, the Sparrow is a force to be reckoned with in a one-on-one,
but can be overwhelmed by a pair of frigates of it's class.

The Sparrow is also outfitted with a large active flare bank, giving it apt protection against enemy missiles. (Think AC-130 style flare dump).
Special thanks to FlashFrozen for sprite help!
Siifran battle groups consist of three Sparrows (one Command, a wing of Two), two full Belken squadrons (one Command, wing of five),
and a support carrier capable of repairs and holding extra supplies (Next project after the Sparrow is finished.)

Siifra IV Militia (S4M) Ships:
S4M Craft are fitted with their signature compact shield generators.
CS Generators have a respectable arc, generate no flux while active, but are inefficient at stopping damage.

Falchion Snubfighter

Spoiler

Main fightercraft of the S4M, the Falchion is well-armored for a fighter.
Equipped with an integrated 3-Point Defense Matrix that draws power from primary weapons and shields.

Paladin Light Snubfighter

Spoiler

A reliable interceptor, the Paladin is one of the fastest combat craft in the sector.
It is moderately armed for it's role but sacrifices armor for it's armament and speed.

Trident Heavy Fighter

Spoiler

An older design, the Trident was meant to pose a threat to larger ships.
It's proprietary beam weapon was designed to disable enemy systems while causing moderate damage at the expense of high flux.
Also has surprising speed for it's role.

Current Missions:

A Day at the Office - Into
Enemy Ace! - First story segemtn
Birdwatching - Sparrow testing
Unboxing - Easter egg ship(s?)

Current Crew:
Vinya: Producing, Sounds, Animations, Mission Design, Old Sprites, Ship Implementation.
LazyWizard: Ship System Coding.
Doogie: Sprites.
Sproginator: Moral Support, General Shenanigans.

Credits:
